regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, energy-led rotation: only 4 of 17 themes are eligible, Energy (H-shares) leads with the strongest durability (0.76) and trend health, while High-Dividend Blue Chips are the nearest challenger. Momentum rank here is a focus lens, not alpha — the validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is currently favoring those trend-healthy, eligible themes and keeping most of the board de-risked.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed handoff from Energy to High-Dividend Blue Chips: if High-Dividend Blue Chips overtakes Energy in score AND its durability_bar exceeds Energy's for 10 consecutive trading days, that would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the clear prevailing narrative: top rank, eligible, strongest durability_bar (0.76), healthy breadth (0.80), and trend-positive hurst tag. The absolute-trend gate — the one validated edge — is validating this theme, so it deserves a directional lean on discipline grounds, not momentum alpha.
theses.dissent: This is a single-narrative concentration in a narrow rotation (only 4/17 eligible); energy leadership in H-shares can be sensitive to global commodity price reversals or a sudden policy shift toward domestic demand, and the theme has no scorable proxy to grade this lean against.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) relative to the Hang Seng turns negative over a rolling 21-day window before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Second strongest eligible theme with solid durability (0.70), trend tag, and respectable breadth (0.625). It benefits from the same absolute-trend gate discipline as Energy and offers a non-resource diversifier within the narrow eligible set.
theses.dissent: Challenger status with a 0.293 margin to the leader suggests it may be a follower rather than an independent narrative; rising global yields could compress dividend-stock appeal, and it lacks a scorable proxy for accountability.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips relative breadth (share of names above trend) falls below 0.40 over a 21-day window before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Third eligible theme and the only mean-reverting hurst tag among the top three — potentially offering a different regime-benefit profile. Eligible status means the absolute-trend gate has not de-risked it, and its crowding_z (0.86) is not flagging a cap.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag and lower durability (0.56) suggest the trend may be less stable than Energy or High-Dividend; a mean-reverting theme can mean-revert against you quickly, and the theme is only modestly broad.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) score drops below the fourth-ranked theme's score within 14 trading days

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
